notes.title: Trading Cards Added
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36058665/4701295ab2f9cc6808cc24814c4c8baf365d38da.jpg[/img]
Good news - trading cards have now been added to The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart 2!

Just play the game to receive them, and craft some awesome Steam background and emoticon rewards!

notes.title: The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart 2 Now Live!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128260/The_Princess_the_Stray_Cat_and_Matters_of_the_Heart_2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36058665/0b667c849fb2b811fb4b3a390c40c9fca18ad5dc.png[/img][/url]
We're happy to announce that The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart 2 is now live on Steam, -20% off until November 15!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128260/The_Princess_the_Stray_Cat_and_Matters_of_the_Heart_2/

Meet new heroines and spend time with your favorites from the first game, enjoy 100+ HD resolution illustrations and top-grade voice acting!

The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart 2 supports English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese, and text can be displayed in two languages at once.

A 70-track original soundtrack is also available now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1186540/The_Princess_the_Stray_Cat_and_Matters_of_the_Heart_2_Original_Soundtrack/

Owners of The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart and previous DLC can enjoy an extra -15% discount through the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/11333/The_Princess_the_Stray_Cat_and_Matters_of_the_Heart__Stray_Cat_Bundle/
]Stray Cat Bundle.[/url]

Please enjoy the wacky invasion of princess Iris December Uncry!

notes.title: The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart 2 Demo and Store Page Live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34547315/154ed3fab20fcd52f8fc3a2aea8c32066b8c3185.png[/img]The store page of The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart 2, the sequel of The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart, is now live!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128260/The_Princess_the_Stray_Cat_and_Matters_of_the_Heart_2

The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart 2 is planned to release on [b]November 8[/b]. Don't forget to wishlist the game to be notified when it launches!

[i]Nora has been working at a beach hut with his friends. One summer's day, snow began to fall along the coastline.

And that... was how he met Iris, the Princess of Winter.[/i]

The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart 2 features 5 lovely new heroines, and you also get to spend more time with the 4 heroines of the first game - all brought to life by top voice actors. 

The full game has an estimated playtime of 35 to 45 hours, and contains over 100 gorgeous illustrations in full HD resolution!

[h1]Demo[/h1]
We've also released a playable demo that you can immediately download from the store page! It features a dual text option which lets you choose 2 languages out of English, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese to display at the same time. We hope you enjoy it!
